ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M2-2,
Light Industry District and RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 28-G in the area bound by:

The public alley next North of and parallel to West 119" Street; a line 99.9 feet east of
and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; West 119" Street; South Ashland Avenue; West
1420" Street; South Ada Street; a line 432 feet south of and parallel to West 119" Street;
a line 403.14 feet West of and parallel to South Ada Street; West 119" Street; a line
139.9 feet east of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue

to those of a RT-3.5, Residential Two-flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Pat et

Alderman, 21% Ward

Common Address:
1544 W. 119" Street
11901 S Ashland Avenue
1441 W. 119" Street
